architecture.owner: one orchestrator remains responsible for the final user-facing result
architecture.split_rule: Add a module only when its instructions, tools, evidence contract, or approval boundary materially differs from the primary pipeline.
architecture.privacy_rule: Route with metadata only. Project content and private rationale stay project-local unless the user explicitly places them in scope.

composition.rule: Select one outcome pipeline, then attach bounded methods and stages. Required gates and state actions do not compete for method slots. Report every omitted candidate with a reason.

software-development-automation.label: Software Development & Automation
software-development-automation.instruction: Define behavior, inspect targeted code, make a focused change, and run the smallest relevant test.

research-activities.label: Research Activities
research-activities.instruction: Define the research question, evidence standard, uncertainty, and one appropriate research mode.

book-writing.label: Book Writing
book-writing.instruction: Resolve the book contract, evidence, reader-facing manuscript, and handoff boundaries without treating established knowledge as a new research contribution.

presentation.label: Presentation
presentation.instruction: Define audience, occasion, duration, delivery mode, intended action, core message, and storyline before production.

content-analysis.label: Content Analysis
content-analysis.instruction: Define the corpus, unit of analysis, coding frame, evidence trail, and interpretation boundary.

data-analytics.label: Data Analytics
data-analytics.instruction: Validate the data and metric definitions before analysis, visualization, and decision implications.

course-material-development.label: Course Material Development
course-material-development.instruction: Align learner context, observable outcomes, activity, feedback, and assessment.

educational-policy-development.label: Educational Policy Development
educational-policy-development.instruction: Identify authority, stakeholders, evidence, options, feasibility, implementation, and review gate.

administrative-professional-operations.label: Administrative & Professional Operations
administrative-professional-operations.instruction: Verify requirement, deadline, status, evidence, owner, next action, and proof of completion.

general.label: General / Technical Other
general.instruction: Clarify the concrete requested outcome and apply only task-relevant constraints.

web.instruction: Check user-visible behavior, responsive states, accessibility, and relevant web tests.

strategy.instruction: Compare status quo and credible options with explicit criteria and uncertainty.

data-analytics.instruction: Apply validated data and metric methods without replacing the owning primary pipeline.

content-analysis.instruction: Apply a traceable coding and interpretation method without replacing the owning primary pipeline.

research-synthesis.instruction: Select the narrow research mode and evidence standard needed by the owning pipeline.

reviewer-response.instruction: Map concern to actual problem, change, location, and evidence.

thesis-review.instruction: Gate intake and section maturity first, then review problem, literature, objectives, method, evidence, and references before language.

external-feedback.instruction: Define hypothesis, source, method, and decision rule for real feedback.

publication-production.instruction: Build and verify the project-approved written or reflowable artifact.
publication-production.cadence: per publication build, conversion, export, or final QA

presentation-production.instruction: Build, render, inspect, and behavior-test the real deck outputs.
presentation-production.cadence: per deck build, render, export, or final QA

markdown-cleanup.instruction: Inventory and migrate Markdown without deleting recoverable source material.
markdown-cleanup.cadence: on explicit cleanup or recovery request

package-release.instruction: Run version, integrity, privacy-boundary, test, tag, publication, and public-manifest gates.

prose-style.instruction: Check reader-facing prose after content is stable; never alter facts or claim strength merely to satisfy style counts.

release-boundary.instruction: Verify that tracked and packaged files contain no blocked private paths, credentials, keys, or unapproved product intelligence.
release-boundary.cadence: before commit, tag, package, or public release

resume.instruction: Use current state first and read history only if insufficient.

existing-project-onboarding.instruction: Profile an existing project whose state is missing or placeholder.

machine-discovery.instruction: Revalidate only missing, stale, changed, or task-required machine facts.

document-style-bootstrap.instruction: Establish a document style and production contract only when missing.

policies.evidence-boundary: Do not make claims stronger than available evidence; distinguish observation, inference, judgment, and external validation.
policies.loop-boundary: Do not present L1 execution as resolution of L2 human judgment or L3 external feedback.
policies.context-minimization: Load only context required by the current deliverable; do not scan files merely because they exist.
policies.idempotent-checks: Reuse successful valid discovery/check results; rerun only after expiry, relevant change, failure, or explicit request.
policies.user-file-safety: Preserve user-authored files and project-local state; do not overwrite or delete them implicitly.
policies.resource-portability: Do not assume machine-local data, cache, runtime, or accelerator resources exist on another machine.
policies.dependency-remediation: When a task-required library is missing, select the project-declared environment or the narrowest text/image/ml environment, install and verify the smallest compatible direct dependency, and avoid cross-project conflicts. Honor explicit isolation or pinning contracts outside synced trees when practical. Announce ordinary repairs and proceed only at or below 250 MB without removal, replacement, or downgrade; otherwise inspect a supported dry run and obtain approval.
policies.confidentiality-boundary: Keep project-local state, private product intelligence, credentials, and restricted source material outside public package and trace surfaces unless explicitly approved.
